questions.fact: To start a new colony! Swarming is how a honeybee colony reproduces, splitting one colony into two.

questions.q: Which queen leaves the hive with the swarm?
questions.fact: The old queen! She leaves with thousands of workers, and a new queen takes over the old hive.

questions.q: What do bees do right before they swarm?
questions.fact: They fill up on honey for the trip. With full bellies and no home to defend, swarms are usually pretty gentle.

questions.q: Who picks the swarm's new home?
questions.fact: Scout bees! They inspect possible homes and dance to vote until the swarm agrees on the best spot.
